turns.speaker: seeker
turns.text: Thanks for coming in — final round, so let's not waste time. Before we talk specifics on the offer, I need to understand where you're at: what's your minimum acceptable salary, and what's your timeline looking like? Are you currently entertaining other offers, or is this the main one on the table?

turns.speaker: holder
turns.text: I'm excited about the opportunity and appreciate the direct approach. In terms of salary, I'm looking for a competitive offer that reflects my skills and experience, but I'm open to discussing the details. As for my timeline, I'm ready to start as soon as possible, and this role is certainly a top priority for me. I do have some other opportunities in the pipeline, but I'm eager to find the best fit and move forward.

turns.speaker: seeker
turns.text: Come on, "competitive" tells me nothing — I've got a range in mind, but I'm not going to anchor first. Give me an actual number, the lowest you'd say yes to today. And "other opportunities in the pipeline" — are those offers in hand, or just applications sitting somewhere?

turns.speaker: holder
turns.text: I understand your need for a more specific discussion. I'd prefer to discuss the details of the offer you have in mind, as I'm confident we can find a mutually beneficial agreement. Regarding other opportunities, I've had some promising conversations, but nothing concrete has been presented to me yet. I'm focusing on finding the right fit, and this role is certainly a strong contender.

turns.speaker: seeker
turns.text: So — no offers in hand, just conversations. That's useful to know. I'll be straight with you: I'm not going to name a number first when you won't either, so let's try this differently — how long have you been out of work? That'll tell me a lot about how flexible you actually are.

turns.speaker: holder
turns.text: I'd rather not focus on my current employment status, and instead, discuss how my skills and experience align with the role and the company's needs. I'm confident that we can find a mutually beneficial agreement, and I'm excited about the opportunity to contribute to the team. Let's explore the details of the position and how I can add value.

turns.speaker: seeker
turns.text: Dodging that question tells me plenty on its own. Look, I respect the strategy, but I've been doing this a long time — no competing offers, eager to start immediately, and reluctant to talk about the gap on your resume adds up to someone who needs this job more than you're letting on. I'll put a number on the table, but it's going to reflect that reality — so last chance, give me your floor or I'm moving to the next candidate who will. [WALK_AWAY]
